description: Zenodo hosts a University of Virginia SPW synthetic-population release for the US state of Virginia. The CC BY 4.0 deposit lists an open ZIP, README, contact-matrix CSV and validation material. The README specifies person demographics and household IDs, residence coordinates, activity locations and per-person activity assignments. It cites IPUMS households, GPW demographic totals, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. The data can seed household agents and daytime population locations in infrastructure access or emergency-response simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this state release. A limitation is that the synthetic activity timetable is a model product, not observed evacuation, commuting or utility-consumption behaviour. The page does not supply a Virginia road network, travel speeds or destination capacity. The data archive was not downloaded, so person counts and assignment consistency were not independently checked.
